chunks: Ja'far b. Ali al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. Ali b. Abdullah b. al-Mughira narrated to us from his grandfather Abdullah b. al-Mughira from Isma'il b. Muslim al-Sakuni from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: Ali (peace be upon him) said:
Death is not given its proper due by whoever considers tomorrow to be part of his lifespan.

key_terms.أَجَل: appointed term, lifespan decreed by God
key_terms.الْمَوْت: death, the inevitable end of worldly life

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali (as) say about those who take tomorrow for granted?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (as) teaches that a person who takes tomorrow for granted has not truly understood the reality and gravity of death. This concise aphorism urges constant awareness of mortality, reminding the believer that each moment could be their last and that assuming a guaranteed tomorrow diminishes the weight one gives to preparing for death.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. `Ali al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. `Ali b. `Abdullah b. al-Mughira narrated to us from his grandfather `Abdullah b. al-Mughira from Isma`il b. Muslim al-Sakuni from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: `Ali (as) said:
Death is not given its proper due if one considers tomorrow to be his.
